title: Home
desc: Sidel CREN is an industrial waste heat recovery platform that captures exhaust heat from boilers, furnaces, flue gas and data center cooling loops and converts it into clean power, water and food.

title: Rotary Particulate Collector (RPC)
desc: Patented, self-cleaning air filtration that removes ~90% of particulates from flue gas while recovering heat — with one moving part.

title: SRU Flue Gas Condenser
desc: Recovers low-grade waste heat and clean condensed water from boiler and furnace exhaust. Proven in industry since 1978.

title: Novacab TESS PCM Heat Storage
desc: Recovered waste heat is banked as latent heat in synthetic phase change material, ready on demand. 2007 ASHRAE Technology Award.

title: ORC + Turbine Power
desc: Converts stored waste heat into clean, dispatchable electricity — adding 20–25% net output from the same plant and the same fuel.

title: Greenhouse & Clean Stack
desc: Cleaned CO₂ and water vapor are routed to greenhouses for year-round food production, jobs, and community value.

title: Industries We Serve
desc: Waste heat recovery applied to dairies, sugar mills, power plants, steel and metals, and data centers via the Sidel CREN platform.

title: Dairy Plant Waste Heat Recovery
desc: Milk handling, pasteurisation, refrigeration and drying — recovered and stored with the Sidel CREN SRU, RPC and Novacab TESS platform.

title: Sugar Mill Cogeneration & Waste Heat Recovery
desc: Bagasse boilers, evaporation, batch pans and condenser water, recovered and stabilised with the Sidel CREN platform.

title: Power Plant Waste Heat Recovery — Gas & Coal
desc: Boiler and generator exhaust, condenser heat and cooling towers, recovered with the Sidel CREN SRU, RPC and Novacab TESS platform.

title: Steel Mill Waste Heat Recovery
desc: Furnace and off-gas heat, EAF, hot rolling and quench systems, recovered with the Sidel CREN platform.

title: Data Center Waste Heat Recovery
desc: Liquid and immersion cooling loops above 122°F, recovered and stored with the Sidel CREN Novacab TESS platform.

title: Concrete Plant Waste Heat Recovery
desc: Curing chambers, boilers, hot condensate and batch-water cooling at precast and prestressed plants, recovered with the Sidel CREN SRU, RPC and Novacab TESS platform.

title: Case Studies
desc: Novacab TESS at IBM's Bromont facility, and the SRU flue-gas condenser at E&J Gallo Winery and Darigold dairy.

title: Our Approach
desc: Capture, store, reuse and convert — delivered through a metered, pilot-first process that proves savings before anyone scales.

title: Leadership & Alliance
desc: Sidel Systems USA, SAI-DEL / Sidel Systems India, and Smart Phases / Novacab — the inventors and operators behind the platform.

title: Contact Sidel CREN
desc: Request a consultation, a data package, or a bankable pilot for your dairy, sugar mill, power plant or steel facility.
